item.text:
Please provide:

- Machine/OS and version
- Service name and how it’s managed (systemd, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
- Exact start command and full error output
- Current status output and relevant recent logs
- When it last worked and what changed since then
- Configuration or dependency changes that may be related
- Whether this is production and any restart/downtime constraints

Please redact passwords, tokens, private keys, and sensitive host details. I won’t access anything until you explicitly authorize it.
